name: WSP Post & Taxonomy Subscriptions Lite
author: wpsuitepro

sections.description:
WSP Post & Taxonomy Subscriptions Lite is designed to keep your audience engaged by providing a seamless way for users to stay updated.

Whether you have a standard blog or a complex site with Custom Post Types (like Products or Portfolios), this plugin handles it all out of the box.

Key Features:
* Universal Support: Works with standard Posts, Pages, and all Custom Post Types.
* Taxonomy Subscriptions: Users can subscribe to Categories, Tags, and all Custom Taxonomies.
* User Dashboard: A professional subscription management area for users using the [wsp_account] shortcode.
* Dynamic Shortcode: Use [wsp_sub_button] to place a subscription button anywhere in your templates or content.
* Customizable Emails: Full control over the subject and content for Welcome, Unsubscribe, and Update notifications.
* Auto-Placement: Automatically appends the subscription button to your content to save time.

Privacy Policy

This plugin stores user IDs, email addresses, and subscription preferences in your local WordPress database to facilitate the sending of notification emails. It does not share this data with any third-party services.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wsp-pts-lite directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure your enabled types at ‘Settings -> WSP Post & Taxonomy Subscriptions Lite’.
sections.faq:
Does it support Custom Post Types?

Yes! The plugin automatically detects all public post types (like Products, Portfolio, etc.) and allows you to enable subscriptions for them.

Where are the emails stored?

All subscriber data and email addresses are stored locally in your WordPress database. No data is sent to external servers by this plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Full support for all Public Post Types and Taxonomies.
